feeds.title: Backyard Taco Blog
feeds.description: Hailing from magical Mazatlan, Mexico, Ruben and Marisela have been sharing their love of good food and their culture since 2005, with family and friends through their establishment, Backyard Taco. They love simple, authentic Mexican food, and that's why they proudly serve only the best quality ingredients. Learn more about the Mexican culture, food, and the people who turned a backyard mesquite grill into one of the most popular taco shops in Arizona.

feeds.title: The Defined Dish » Tacos
feeds.description: Learn recipes for tacos from crispy tacos to fusion with Korean and other cuisines. Welcome! I'm Alex, the foodie behind The Defined Dish. Since I can remember, food and cooking have always been a passion of mine. Growing up I was always the kid helping my mom in the kitchen, and then in college became the girl cooking and testing recipes for my roommates and friends. Now, I am a wife and mom making and testing delicious and nutritious meals for my family.

feeds.title: Half Baked Harvest » Tacos
feeds.description: Explore quick and easy taco recipes. The recipes you'll find here are inspired by the people and places I love most. I come from a family of ten, and a big family means BIG meals. In an effort to tame some of our mealtime chaos and get dinner on the table at a respectable hour, I began to help cook. I soon realized how much I enjoyed it, and before I knew it, I had taken over cooking our meals full-time. I captured the process in photos and documented my best recipes, and that's how Half Baked Harvest was born

feeds.title: Pinch of Yum » Tacos
feeds.description: Isn't everything better when you put it in taco form?! We sure think so. Here are some fresh and delicious taco recipes. Hi, my name is Lindsay. I'm the voice, author, and creator behind Pinch of Yum. What started as a casual hobby over 10 years ago in 2010 while I was working as a fourth-grade teacher has now grown into a full-blown business.

feeds.title: Isabel Eats » Tacos
feeds.description: Looking to spruce up your next Taco Tuesday? These taco recipes are great for easy weeknight Mexican dinners and celebrations like Cinco de Mayo and entertaining. I'm Isabel Orozco-Moore, the founder and owner of Isabel Eats. I started Isabel Eats in 2015 as a way to document my family's recipes and connect to my Mexican heritage. Today, I strive for Isabel Eats to be a resource for others looking to learn more about Mexican cuisine and culture through food and recipes.

feeds.title: Tacos Tacos Tacos Blog
feeds.description: Our Mexican heritage greatly influenced the Tacos Tacos Tacos menu. But, we also put much time and research into gathering the best recipes, and sourcing the best product in order to pay homage to the taqueros from every corner of Mexico. Community is important to us as it is in Mexico, and giving back is part of our mission.

feeds.title: Sac Tacos Blog
feeds.description: We are a Sacramento, CA-based family business that uses only the finest ingredients to make our wide variety of Traditional Mexican Dishes. Trini has been cooking all her life in the family restaurant in Jalisco, Mexico - 20 yrs plus experience. Carlos is also a full-time REA with Lyon's - Sierra Oaks. Trini is a full-time mama and basically runs all the operations for SBTC while Carlos runs all the back-office sales, marketing, and customer service.

feeds.title: I am a Food Blog » Tacos
feeds.description: Read amazing taco recipes. I am a Food Blog is a recipe & travel blog written by husband and wife team Mike & Steph. In its 7 years of existence, it has covered such diverse subjects as mini beef wellingtons, driving through Iceland's ring road, and making pho in a pressure cooker.

feeds.title: Taco Ocho Blog
feeds.description: Taco Ocho is independently owned and operated by Mani Bhushan. You might see Mani working in restaurants, especially at the Flower Mound location which is near his home. Our fresh, made-from-scratch food features bold, authentic flavors inspired by traditional Latin cooking. We use real premium ingredients: fresh produce, all-natural cheeses, sustainably-sourced seafood, and preservative-free tortillas.

feeds.title: L.A. Taco » Tacos
feeds.description: Get to know what is happening in the kitchen of L.A. Taco. L.A. TACO is a platform for the city of Los Angeles. We are a source of news and information covering food, culture, and community in the metropolitan area. We are independently owned and operated, by L.A. and for L.A. In our mission, we aim to bring raw and street-level journalism from all corners of L.A. county to our loyal readers, supporters, members, and partners who share our passion for Los Angeles.

feeds.title: Mike's Red Tacos Blog
feeds.description: We only use high-quality meat for our Birria. The meat is slowly simmered for hours into a blend of authentic spices. We dip our freshly made tortillas into our in-house created chili oil that is then crisped onto the flat top. This gives our tacos their signature red color, and that's why they're called red tacos! Mike's Red Tacos will also serve Birria ramen, and the signature Crunchstack, a take on the Taco Bell Crunchwrap.
